mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_agent_ltm_curated_entry ( stream_id, owner_type, owner_id, scope, content, status, source_session_id, source_request_id, write_origin, create_time, update_time, deleted ) VALUES ( #{streamId}, #{ownerType, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{ownerId}, #{scope, typeHandler=org.wwz.ai.infrastructure.memory.CuratedMemoryScopeTypeHandler}, #{content}, #{status}, #{sourceSessionId}, #{sourceRequestId}, #{writeOrigin}, NOW(), NOW(), 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_agent_ltm_curated_entry SET deleted = 1, status = 'DELETED', update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

UPDATE ai_agent_ltm_curated_entry SET content = #{content}, source_session_id = #{sourceSessionId}, source_request_id = #{sourceRequestId}, write_origin = #{writeOrigin}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
